verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs say users can install desktop apps with one click from Fedora's repositories or Flathub, and install packages with a single command. The 'thousands of applications' scale of the official catalog is never documented. One community report says some popular apps (Discord, Spotify) needed a page of commands instead of a catalog install. Missing for 10: any evidence of catalog size (thousands of apps), a named official software-center description, and independent hands-on corroboration of smooth catalog installs.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can install thousands of applications directly from an official software catalog

citations.quote: Easily install the very best desktop apps with the click of a button from Fedora's repositories, Flathub or anywhere else.
Easily install, update and manage software packages
All the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command.
